title: docs: Remove user interface section from Wireshark man page
description:
Point to the WSUG, which is much more detailed, up to date
(the man page describes the UI from the GTK days), and has
pictures. The WSUG is usually distributed with the program.

Reorder a few items not in their current menus in the WSUG.
Add Show Packet Bytes. Add a few minor details from the man page.
